```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
ps <- collect(tbl(con, "ps_change"))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
# The current college season is still being played, so its partial stat lines
# are left out of the shares (decision 0053 and the card rules).
through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
ev <- transfer_events(ps) |>
  filter(season <= through)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Each transfer, sorted by where the new school sits in the tier order. The
# same-tier bar is highlighted because it is the answer to the question.
dir_tab <- ev |>
  count(direction, name = "moves") |>
  mutate(
    share = moves / sum(moves),
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: %s transfers (%.1f%%)",
      direction,
      formatC(moves, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
      100 * share
    ),
    label = sprintf("%.1f%% (%s)", 100 * share, formatC(moves, big.mark = ",", format = "d"))
  )

p <- ggplot(dir_tab, aes(100 * share, reorder(direction, share))) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = direction == "Same tier",
      tooltip = tip,
      data_id = as.character(direction)
    ),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.05, size = 4.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "gray65")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  expand_limits(x = 60) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Transfers by direction of tier change",
    subtitle = "Share of transfers; dark: same competition tier",
    x = "Share of transfers",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "transfer-direction", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: direction-by-season
# The same split season by season from 2016, when transfers are counted well
# enough to split by direction.
dir_season <- ev |>
  filter(season >= 2016) |>
  count(season, direction, name = "moves") |>
  group_by(season) |>
  mutate(season_share = moves / sum(moves)) |>
  ungroup()

p_season <- ggplot(
  dir_season,
  aes(season, 100 * season_share, colour = direction)
) +
  geom_line_interactive(
    aes(data_id = as.character(direction), tooltip = as.character(direction)),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      data_id = as.character(direction),
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%d, %s: %.1f%% of that season's transfers (%s)",
        season,
        direction,
        100 * season_share,
        formatC(moves, big.mark = ",", format = "d")
      )
    ),
    size = 2.6
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "To a higher tier" = "#1D4ED8",
      "Same tier" = "#374151",
      "To a lower tier" = "#9CA3AF"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2016:through) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "The direction mix season by season",
    subtitle = "Share of each season's transfers by direction",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Share of transfers (%)",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a point for the count. Seasons before 2016 have too few observed transfers to split."
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_season)
```

```{r}
#| label: cast-table
# The recurring cast's transfers, keyed on the CFBD athlete id (never on name).
cast <- running_cast()
ev |>
  filter(playerId %in% cast, season >= 2016) |>
  arrange(player, season) |>
  transmute(
    player = player,
    season = season,
    from = prev_team,
    to = team,
    direction = as.character(direction)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Player", "Season", "From", "To", "Direction"),
    caption = "Recurring-cast players' transfers from 2016 on, with the direction of each move."
  )
```
